using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

class Program
{
    private static int count;
    private static string numbers;
    static bool IsEven(double n)
    {
        return ((n % 2) == 0);
    }
    static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        count = 0;
        numbers = "";
        foreach (var x in numbers)
        {
            if (IsEven(x))
            {
                count = (count + 1);
            }
        }
        Console.WriteLine(count);
    }
}
